```{=html}
<noscript>
  <h1>Kleene equivalence</h1>
  <p>State elimination converts an automaton into a regular expression by induction over allowed intermediate states. Structural induction converts a regular expression into an epsilon-NFA, which can then be stripped of epsilon transitions.</p>
</noscript>
```
